title: The Kitab-i-Iqan
author: Baha'u'llah
description: Baha'u'llah's Book of Certitude explores the interpretation of scripture, the recognition of divine messengers and the continuity of religious revelation. It is a foundational introduction to the Baha'i understanding of faith and spiritual knowledge.
